metadata.description: Foreman: a discipline layer for Claude Code (intake, planning, focus, evidence, guard, memory hygiene).

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Plans, sequences, tracks and verifies work from terse prompts: evidence-gated briefs, focus lock, exact resume, a bypass-mode guard, drive mode and memory hygiene.

plugins.name: foreman-ui
plugins.description: Foreman inside Claude Code (mods): one docked panel that fits the screen and never jumps (what needs you, the task with its stage rail and progress, what runs now, live charts of the session, the queue), a band above the prompt when it's closed, toasts and one-press approve/next/drive/inbox actions. Needs a Claude Code build with function-hook plugins.
